ai.summary: The channel has 97,283 views, but 85,900 of them (88%) come from two videos: Elysium part 1 (31,100) and an untagged part 12 (54,800). Across 50 videos the average watch is only 6.2 s and 1.5% of viewers reach the end, so the opening hook and the cliffhanger endings are the first things to fix.

actions: Keep making recap parts as the core format, since recap holds 34 of 50 videos and produced the top hit
Open every part with the most tense or twisty beat in the first 3 seconds, because average watch is only 6.2 s
End each recap part on a cliffhanger and keep the next part's tease in the caption, aiming for the short-part pattern that worked on 10 Cloverfield Lane
Let the 165 s part length run for several days before changing it, since there is no post-change data yet, and pause stretch mode while it averages 97 views per video
